result.topic_en: Calculation of the value of Riemann's series f(x)=Σ (nx)/n² (with (x) the sawtooth/fractional-part function) at rational points x = m/(2n), giving π²/(16n²), and a sketch of a sum over subdivision points of [0,1].
result.transcription:
$(x)$. $\sum_{1,\infty} \frac{(nx)}{n^2}$
$fx = \frac{(x)}{1} + \frac{(2x)}{4} + \frac{(3x)}{9} +$

$= \frac{1}{n^2} \frac{1}{2} \sum \frac{1}{(2s+1)^2}$
$= \frac{\pi^2}{16 n^2}$

methods.what: Definition of the series f(x) = Σ (nx)/n² where (x) is the sawtooth function
Evaluation of the jump/contribution at x = m/(2n) by summing over odd multiples, using Σ 1/(2s+1)² = π²/8
Summation of the values of f over subdivision points of [0,1]
